title: Axiom of extensionality
summary: Two sets are equal when they have exactly the same members.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared first-order set theory context is fixed.

content.plain: Two sets are equal when they have exactly the same members.
content.example: The written sets {1,2} and {2,1} have the same members and are equal.
content.caveat: Extensionality does not say which sets exist; it constrains equality among sets that do.
